rejectedHypotheses.replacementBoundary: OriginalOnline dispatch is mode and zero-interference evidence only.
Authority tick commits only after a successful steady-standard Room::Update transaction.
The site is only a controller-assignment candidate.
The logical query slots are demand-driven pressed, triggered, and scalar queries.
Raw projection follows the concrete Keyboard or Gamepad physical-poll return.
Ordinary-door ownership uses the proven room-change owner and nested simulation transaction.
Physical polling continues while the steady-standard Authority transaction is absent.
Device reassignment requires unique before and after assignment joins plus the loop-local refresh transaction.
A same-family multi-candidate transaction is ambiguity-only and earns no proof.
Pointers and device keys are generation-local associations; stable identity is ClientId and LocalPlayerOrdinal.
Menu return may reuse roots, so retirement follows explicit lifecycle and generation events.
An undelivered unreliable send is loss diagnostics, not a gate failure by itself.
